comparisonToDirectQemu.observableDifference: ESXi vmware.log explicitly reports a DirectPath reset attempt; neither path clears the EDU liveness state on warm reboot

inference: MSI-only DirectPath is functional in this nested profile: the guest selected MSI, VMware enabled physical MSI/vmm interrupt handling, and each programmed EDU DMA completion was followed by an outer interrupt-remapping event.
The guest DMA addresses are inside the outer VT-d 2 MiB translation range for requester 01:01.0; exact string equality to the range base is not a valid correlation rule.
The reset log is evidence that VMware entered its reset path, not evidence that endpoint-internal state was cleared.
QEMU EDU has no observed endpoint reset callback in this build, so persisted state cannot identify VMware's physical reset type or predict a real NIC/NVMe/GPU reset outcome.
A production parity test still needs an endpoint with a reset generation register wired to FLR/SBR/D3 callbacks, or E4 real-hardware evidence.
